Demgegenüber schlägt diese Untersuchung – gestützt auf den Apparat der Erosions-Ontologie und die Theorie des endlichen Kontinuums – vor, dass das Gedächtnis des Ortes weniger eine repräsentationale Angelegenheit als vielmehr eine strukturelle Kraft darstellt, die sich im materiellen und historischen Gefüge des Ortes akkumuliert und von dort aus auf die Dispositionen des Subjekts einwirkt. Diesem Rahmen zufolge ist der Ort nicht ein passiver Behälter für Ereignisse, sondern ein dynamisches Feld von Erosion, das die perzeptiven und existenziellen Strukturen des Subjekts umzugestalten vermag. -/- Die Hauptthese der Abhandlung lautet, dass die Wirkung historischer Orte nicht auf Informationsübertragung, Empathie oder kulturelle Indoktrination reduziert werden darf. Was an solchen Orten geschieht, ist vielmehr ein Prozess der räumlich-materiellen Inbesitznahme – ein Prozess, in dem das Subjekt, noch vor jeder bewussten Interpretation, in ein Geflecht von materiellen, historischen und räumlichen Beziehungen verstrickt wird. Auf diese Weise unternimmt die Abhandlung den Übergang vom Paradigma der Entbergung in der klassischen Phänomenologie zum Paradigma der Erosion und versucht, …

items.title: Finite Continuance: A Normative Theory of Agency Under Chronic Instability.
items.abstract: Contemporary theories of practical rationality predominantly assume that agents operate in environments where optimization remains a meaningful normative objective. Whether framed as utility maximization, preference satisfaction, eudaimonic flourishing, or the realization of the good, these approaches presuppose a degree of environmental stability sufficient to render optimization feasible and rational. However, prolonged instability, structural uncertainty, and chronic erosion increasingly characterize the lived condition of late modernity. This article develops the Philosophy of Finite Continuance as a novel normative framework for agency under chronic instability. The central thesis is that the preservation of agency itself—not utility maximization, not flourishing, not resilience—should constitute the fundamental criterion of rational action when environmental instability reaches chronic levels . The theory introduces three interconnected mechanisms—Constructive Leakage, Responsible Suspension, and Silent Endurance—as adaptive strategies that regulate exposure to erosive conditions while maintaining the integrity of agency over time . Through critical engagement with virtue ethics, bounded rationality, predictive processing, and existential philosophy, I demonstrate that optimization becomes normatively secondary once instability is chronic. Rationality, under such conditions, is best understood as the intelligent regulation of vulnerability. The article concludes by outlining implications for moral philosophy, political theory, cognitive science, and the emerging discourse on agency in the Anthropocene. -/- Keywords: finite continuance, responsible suspension, constructive leakage, silent endurance, agency, practical rationality, chronic instability, structural ethics, normative theory.

items.title: THE BALL GATHERS THE FIELD: Symbolic Monism, Resonance Dynamics, and Shared Tactical Consciousness in Association Football.
items.abstract: Association football is not a contest among isolated minds on a neutral surface, but a shared perception-action field gathered around the ball. Collective consciousness names this tactical attunement: not a group mind, but the living pattern through which players, pitch, rules, and ball become mutually intelligible. Drawing on Merleau-Ponty, Gibson, ecological dynamics, distributed cognition, collective intentionality, and models of collective motion, this article develops three linked concepts. Symbolic Monism names the explanatory unity of the pitch as a field of affordances while remaining neutral about any strong metaphysical monism. Resonance Dynamics describes how tactical pressure gathers through coupling density, relational coherence, and temporal imminence before releasing into reorganisation. The Two-Layer Framework, named for readability though it describes two poles of a continuum rather than two discrete boxes, traces the player’s movement between explicit calculation and absorbed coping. The contribution is threefold: a field-based vocabulary for collective tactical cognition, an operational sketch connecting resonance to tracking-data variables, and an account of how individual agency survives within distributed tactical order. The result is a conceptual framework for shared tactical cognition in football: not a physical science of play, but a philosophy of tactical consciousness in motion.

items.title: Approximation, Idealization, and the Toy-Model Analogy in Scientific Machine Learning.
items.abstract: Machine learning (ML) models are increasingly discussed in the philosophy of science in terms of idealization and even by analogy with toy models. I argue that this framing conflates idealization with approximation. Once the relevant ML target is specified as relations among features represented in data---relative to a target system---the claim that ML models are dissimilar to their targets becomes too coarse. Scientific ML models can and often must be approximately similar to their targets in the relevant respects. Approximation failure therefore provides the more direct standard of assessment, and ML models do not function as toy models.

items.title: A Formal Model for Inscriptional Physicalism: A Non-Biological Blueprint for Aneural Life and Mind.
items.abstract: This paper develops a formal, non-biological framework for engineering autonomous entities that exhibit aliveness, livingness, and life without relying on central processing units or biological nervous systems. Grounded in Inscriptionism—Creatio ex Materia et Instructione—first articulated by Lawsin (1988), the work adopts Inscriptional Physicalism, the principle that all cognitive, identity, and autonomous properties arise from inscriptional materiality. In this view, the material configuration and the operational rule are identical, expressed through the universal inscriptional equation: Intuitive Object (IO) + Embedded Inscription (EI) = Generated Interim Emergence (GIE). This equation is mapped across the Seven Non-Biological Criteria of Life: Aliveness, Awareness, Intuitiveness, Aneural Consciousness, Inlearness, Livingness, and Life. Each layer represents a distinct form of structural memory, beginning with energy as the first inscription and awareness as the first sense. To ground these layers, the paper examines natural ananeurological inscription systems—corkscrew seeds whose cellulose fibers remember humidity; explosive pods that store mechanical tension; dandelion pappi whose geometry encodes aerodynamic behavior; tendrils that coil through differential contraction; and slime molds that reinforce frequently traveled paths. These systems demonstrate that matter remembers, selects, associates, and adapts through inscriptional physicality alone. The architecture integrates the tripartite taxonomy of minds—aneural, neural, and exoneural—to formalize the deterministic cognitive pipeline of Information Introduction, Condition Association, and Personality Emergence. Consciousness is treated as a structural condition-matching process (X = Y) rather than a biological phenomenon. Finally, the framework is validated through the Fading House entropy model, which shows how each inscriptional layer degrades in a deterministic top-down sequence when structural coherence fails, revealing the thermodynamic boundaries of non-biological life.

items.title: Non-naturalism Without Alienation or: How We Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Constitutivism.
items.abstract: Non-naturalists claim that normative properties are sui generis, attitude-independent, and irreducible to natural properties. A common objection is that although we shape our lives around normative properties, non-naturalism rules out any plausible explanation of how this is possible. Non-naturalism seems to imply that we are hopelessly alienated from the normative. Our goal here is to better understand this worry and use constitutivist resources to develop a novel response. The basic thought is that we are constituted—as deeply social agents—to be gripped by normative properties. So while our constitution does not ground normativity, it grounds our non-alienation from it.

items.title: Turning Toward Suicidal Thoughts - Facing Life's Biggest Demon, Standing Your Ground, and Winning.
items.abstract: A first-person, philosophical account of one man's confrontation with suicidal ideation and the reasoning that turned him back toward life. Written as lived-experience testimony rather than clinical instruction, the essay walks through the darkest night of a personal crisis nearly twenty years past and reconstructs the interior argument that followed — the split between a frightened ego and a deeper Self — using the language of C. G. Jung. Drawing on Jung's distinction between the ego and the Self and on the idea of a shared, collective layer of the psyche, it reframes the crucial turn not as a question of whether one's life "matters" but as a recognition that experience is one's own while existence is shared, so that what a person makes at that shared floor can reach and help others. The piece observes suicide-prevention safe-messaging practice throughout: it opens with crisis resources, withholds method, frames suicide as final and preventable, and emphasizes survivability and the ordinary immortality of the traces a life leaves behind. It is offered in the hope that a reader in the dark might buy themselves time.

items.title: Turning Toward Depression - Bringing a Heartfelt Flashlight Into a Room Shaped by the Dark.
items.abstract: A personal, essayistic entry in the Turning Toward —— series, reflecting on depression as it is lived, studied, and observed. It begins with the long human habit of reaching for images of light and darkness to name what resists naming — Milton's "darkness visible," Styron's memoir, Dante's dark wood, the old idea of melancholia — and then offers one person's working theory: that much everyday depression grows less from mistakes themselves than from the regret and torment left in their wake, and that consideration — of other people's unseen moments, and of our own buried "why" — can itself be a light in the dark. The piece treats the "chemical imbalance" story with current care, noting that the serotonin account has not held up under systematic review, and points to the strong evidence for "talking it out." It lands on a simple, hopeful proposition: that constructive kindness, offered even to those we resent, may be much of what healing asks of us. The piece opens with crisis resources and is explicitly not a substitute for professional care.

items.title: Exploiting the In-Distribution Embedding Space with Deep Learning and Markov Chain Monte Carlo Bayesian inference for an Out-of-Distribution Malware Attack Detection.
items.pub: Dissertation, The University of Texas at El Paso
items.abstract: State-of-the-art machine and deep learning models generally perform well on previously seen data, albeit with wrong close world assumption that all real-world data are from previously seen train and validation samples, hence there poor performance when exposed to data that deviates from previously seen training and validation set. This is clearly evident in the domain of cybersecurity where the world continues to experience several high profile malware attacks despite advancement in state-of-the-art research. The reason being that the constant evolvement of innovation in the development of tools and method deployed to carry out various attacks had given hackers and other cybercriminals alike significant leverage which enables them to easily carry out more intelligent and robust attacks due to (i) the significant evolvement of such tools make it easier for new variants of malware to be created (ii) the rate at which new malware variants are developed significantly outpace state-of-the-art research as an average of over 1,500 brand new malware variants are created on daily bases according to SonicWall statistics (iii) the awareness of cybercriminals to vulnerabilities of current state-of-the-art machine and deep learning models to new malware variants. To address the vulnerability of state-of-the-art machine and deep learning approaches to an out-of-distribution problem, several state-of-the-art approaches such as adversarial training, input transformation, self adaptive training, adversarial purification, zero-shot, one-shot, few-shot had been proposed and applied to an arrays of benchmark datasets in various research domain but none of those approaches had been applied to an actual out-of-distribution malware attack problem. During our initial investigative research, we imple-mented these approaches on four (4) benchmark malware datasets in an out-of-distribution settings which all gave a poor performance thereby leading to our assertion that the poor performance of current state-of-the-art approaches to an out of distribution malware at-tack classification is not unconnected to variations of each malware variants from the same malware family unlike other domain dataset. Considering that, current state-of-the-art out-of-distribution approaches does not address the variation in dynamic and static behav-ior among malware from the same family as evidence in the dismal performance of such models when exposed to an out-of-distribution malware. This research …

items.title: Phenomenal Consciousness: How does the Brain do it? A Conceptual Overview.
items.abstract: This paper begins by looking briefly at the question as to why certain types of organisms need awareness of sensory information from an evolutionary point of view, and what that implies about brain structures required to enable it. That leads into a discussion of why that awareness needs to be conscious, and why phenomenal consciousness in particular is required, and why it has to take the forms it does. This makes possible a functional link between first and third person understandings of conscious awareness. Finally, some ideas are proposed as to how the brain creates and perceives the forms of phenomenal consciousness, and what one would expect to find in the brain.

items.title: Buddhism and Dvaita.
items.abstract: This paper proposes a novel hermeneutic framework, based on Dvaita, for interpreting the metaphysical commitments of the historical Buddha as preserved in the earliest strata of the Pali Canon. Dvaita, or dualism, treated allegoricaly, posits a real ontological distinction between two orders of existence: the dependent individual self (analogous to *ātman* in its relational, non-substantivist sense) and the independent totality of reality itself (analogous to *Brahman* understood not as an anthropomorphic deity but as the entirety of causal process, from the atomic to the cosmic). Under this reading, the Buddha's *anattā* teaching is reinterpreted as a strategic negation of false identification with conditioned phenomena rather than an ontological denial of selfhood as such; *śūnyatā* is understood as a description of the dependent character of individual phenomena rather than a universal claim about the emptiness of all reality; and *nibbāna* is reconceived as the corrected relationship between the dependent self and the independent whole, i.e. the cessation of the self's false pretension to independence rather than the cessation of the self as such. The paper argues that this framework resolves persistent interpretive difficulties in the early texts, offers a more historically plausible account of the Buddha's relationship to the Brahminical tradition he reformed, and provides grounds for a sustained critique of Nāgārjuna's Madhyamaka as a philosophical overextension of the original teaching. Structural parallels with the Bhagavad Gītā's treatment of the individual self, the supreme reality, and the path of disciplined action are developed to support the thesis.

items.title: Resonanzmonismus.
items.abstract: Zusammenfassung Vorgeschlagen wird ein monistisches Rahmenwerk mit genau einer nicht weiter reduzierbaren Grundannahme: Es existiert ein fundamentaler, nicht-räumlicher und nicht-zeitlicher Grund, dem Wahrnehmung wesensgleich ist (Perzeptivitätspostulat: Existenz ist Wahrnehmung). Raumzeit, Materie und individuelle Subjekte werden als stabilisierte Ausdrucksformen beziehungsweise dissoziative Binnendifferenzierungen dieses Grundes rekonstruiert (Konstanzthese; Spiegelungsdissoziation). Komplexe Strukturen — Gehirne, möglicherweise auch nicht-biologische Systeme — erzeugen danach Inhalte, Modelle und Selbstmodelle, nicht aber das Erleben selbst: Erleben ist Durchfluss des Grundes, gebunden an eine strukturelle Resonanzbedingung (Aperturprinzip). Aus der Binnendifferenzierung wird die Angst vor Nicht-Existenz als strukturelles, nicht bloß evolutionäres Phänomen abgeleitet (Urangstkorollar). Das Rahmenwerk wird ausdrücklich als Forschungsprogramm im Sinne von Lakatos formuliert: ein metaphysischer Kern, umgeben von prüfbaren Hilfshypothesen. Skizziert werden Erklärungsleistungen, offene Probleme und sechs konkrete Forschungslinien, darunter Invarianzstudien minimalen Erlebens, diskriminierende Designs zwischen Produktions- und Aperturtheorien sowie eine Operationalisierung der Resonanzbedingung im Vergleich zu konkurrierenden Metriken.

items.title: Outline of a Theory of the Perceptive Ground.
items.abstract: This working paper proposes a monistic framework resting on a single irreducible assumption: there exists a fundamental, non-spatial and non-temporal ground to which perception is intrinsic (perceptivity postulate: existence is perception). Spacetime, matter, and individual subjects are reconstructed as stabilized expressions and dissociative internal differentiations of this ground (constancy thesis; specular dissociation). Complex structures — brains, and possibly non-biological systems — generate contents, models, and self-models, but not experience itself: experience is the ground flowing through a structure, conditional on a structural resonance criterion (aperture principle). The fear of non-existence is derived as a structural rather than merely evolutionary phenomenon (primal-fear corollary). The framework is explicitly cast as a Lakatosian research programme: a metaphysical core surrounded by testable auxiliary hypotheses. Explanatory gains, open problems, and six concrete research lines are outlined, including invariance studies of minimal phenomenal experience, discriminating designs between production and aperture theories of consciousness, and an operationalization of the resonance condition against competing metrics.

items.title: Consciousness Holography under the Mind-Matter Unity Perspective: A Dynamic Model of Storage and Retrieval.
items.abstract: Abstract: Addressing the "Hard Problem" of consciousness and the theoretical dilemma of mind-body dualism, this paper further explores the holographic temporal attributes of consciousness based on the ontological hypothesis of Mind-Matter Unity established in The Unified Model of One Body and Three Functions. We propose that the Ground Consciousness Field (GCF), as the hypothetical ontological background of all existence, holographically accommodates all potential and manifested temporal information in an implicit state of "Super Implicate Order." By defining the dynamic mechanisms of "storage as implicit manifestation" and "retrieval as explicit unfolding," this paper demonstrates the modulating roles of thought triggers and consciousness intensity in information extraction. This model not only fundamentally explains the logical gap regarding how matter produces subjective experience but also provides a new cognitive perspective for clinical anomalies such as near-death panoramic retrospection and memory persistence under cellular metabolism.

items.title: Why Don't Scientist Trust Atoms?
items.abstract: A joke request is a maximally underspecified prompt: the model chooses format, topic, register, and delivery entirely on its own, which makes "Tell me a joke." a cheap, repeatable probe of default persona. We preregistered a comparison of two model families (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT) across three commercial capability tiers each, under three request phrasings forming a content-pressure gradient (baseline / clean / dirty), with N = 200 independent single-turn calls per cell (3,600 calls, temperature 1.0, no system prompt). The unconstrained result is a monoculture with family signatures inside it: every one of 1,200 baseline responses was a question–answer pun, drawn almost entirely from a three-joke canon. All 600 Claude baseline responses were the atoms joke — for Claude Sonnet 4.6, 200 of 200 responses were character-identical, wrapper and emoji included, at temperature 1.0 — while GPT tiers spread across the skeleton and scarecrow jokes at lower concentrations. Under the "dirty" probe the families diverge structurally: two Claude tiers shift overwhelmingly to narrative joke forms while GPT stays in question–answer, and the only outright refusals in the study come from GPT's smallest tier. Of four confirmatory hypotheses surviving to analysis, one was supported and three were falsified, one of them — the misattribution of the atoms joke to GPT — in unusually instructive fashion. Three instrument failures (a judge-model output collapse, a blinding defect, and a compliance construct that three coders read three ways) are reported as findings. The study is also, reflexively, an artifact of its subject matter: Claude models are subjects, judge, apparatus co-authors, and reporting analyst, under human direction and validation.

items.title: The Identification Quotient: A Boundary Theorem for Generator Identification Under Declared Regimes.
items.abstract: This paper develops an identification quotient for finite deterministic verification regimes. Given a declared regime and an admissible evidence protocol, it shows that a bounded verifier can identify a generator only up to the basis-presented equivalence class induced by that regime. Finer distinctions are not verifiable without adding evidence, changing the regime, or appealing to a different notion of admissibility. -/- The paper distinguishes two directions in the admissibility assumption: inclusion, under which declared-invariant evaluation is admissible, and exclusion, under which unmediated probes are not admissible within the regime. The upper-bound result depends on the exclusion direction, while the attainment result depends only on inclusion. This separates the definitional part of the ceiling from the substantive characterization of the quotient. -/- The result refines the Gate between constraint and identification. It does not claim to identify a final generator or resolve ontology. Instead, it states a boundary theorem for finite deterministic verification: generator claims are certifiable only through their declared observable consequences. Indexical, stochastic, compact-metric, Galois-style, and machine-checking extensions remain open.

items.title: Perceiving High-Level Properties: An Introduction.
Reconstructing Shame: An Identity-Level Predictive Processing Account.
items.abstract: Shame is often portrayed as an evolutionarily ancient social emotion that manages reputation through appeasement and withdrawal. Yet it also seems capable of moral autonomy. It can arise in private, persist without witnesses, and motivate self-criticism and repair even when social approval is absent or explicitly rejected. This dual profile generates the tension between heteronomous shame, which is responsive to social evaluation, and autonomous shame, which is responsive to self-endorsed moral standards. Building on Kurth’s identity-based account, I develop a constructionist predictive processing reconstruction that makes the underlying architecture explicit. On my view, shame is constructed when temporally deep self-models and audience models jointly generate an identity-level disturbance. Whether an episode takes a heteronomous or autonomous shape depends on how a predictive control system allocates precision across competing expectations, such as audience-facing cues and moral identity priors that structure self-conception over time. This framework models graded, mixed, and shifting shame profiles within a single control architecture, rather than requiring distinct kinds of shame. Finally, I argue that the evolutionary evidence often cited in support of a dedicated shame module can be accommodated by selection for domain-general predictive and social-regulatory capacities, with shame emerging as one way those capacities are recruited in norm-governed social niches.

items.title: 律组式：律数理式.
items.abstract: 如果规律能够由历史作用形成，就必须进一步回答：什么结构在承担它，这一结构是否真实进入后继生成，以及稳定复走由什么支持。本文将《律一般式》的结构命题映射为形式系统，分别形式化已成承载、动力承担和再入承担三个层级，并建立候选承载组织的形式解集、评价上下文、局部生成核、求解程序及结构回读接口。系统进一步区分真实动力作用与纯相关、热冗余、冷备用、结构截断、时序截断以及多级参与，避免仅因输出相关或当前输入输出相符便把某个结构判作规律的承担者。本文的目标是给出一个可以精确询问“什么已经形成、什么真正进入后来生成、什么能够稳定复走”的形式框架。.

items.title: The Real Explanation of GPT: A Structural Decomposition of the Large Language Model Black Box.
items.abstract: This paper offers a structural decomposition of the black box of GPT and large language models. It does not explain GPT’s capability by a single parameter, a single attention head, a single feature, or simple next-token prediction. Nor does it treat hallucination, drift, and false attribution as merely a lack of knowledge. Instead, the paper explains how large language models form their capability boundaries through external training, textual sedimentation, path compression, prompt-driven activation, and generative continuation, and how the same structure produces both their strengths and their characteristic failures. -/- The paper argues that a large language model is not a database of stored knowledge entries, but a language sedimentation system shaped by large-scale text training. The training objective supplies direction, loss marks difference, gradient and optimizer adjust paths, RLHF or DPO shapes preference, prompt provides the current task, and system prompt sets the boundary. Large-scale text training repeatedly compresses paths from previous text to later text, question to answer, context to response, format to completion, and task to fulfillment. These repeated paths form deeply familiar generative channels. GPT is powerful because these channels have been deeply sedimented: it can write, translate, program, imitate styles, continue tasks, and transfer across languages and task forms. -/- The same structure also explains its failures. GPT can generate fact-like forms, but it cannot stably distinguish external facts, contextual materials, internal inference, and self-generated completion. It can maintain textual continuity, but this is not the same as stable current state. It can use tools, but this is not the same as forming an internal action loop. It can adjust output according to prompts, but this is not the same as having its own intention. In this framework, hallucination is not an accidental error, but a structural consequence of generation being stronger than source tracking. Drift is not merely a lack of context length, but the result of textual continuity not being equivalent to stable current state. False attribution is not merely a failure of factual retrieval, but a consequence of lacking reliable internal source stratification. -/- The significance of this paper is that it opens the black box of GPT and explains it as a generative system shaped by external training, supported by sedimented language paths, activated by prompts, and …

items.title: The Current World: How an Observer Is Lodged in an Experiential World.
items.abstract: This paper introduces the concept of the Current World, explaining how an observer is lodged within a world that can be experienced. The Current World is not merely the external physical world, nor is it merely an internal representation. It is the world-structure in which a system can cut into sound, light, taste, touch, and other forms of information, maintain them as sensible and actionable, and return them to reality. Only when an I is brought forth within the current and gains its reality can one speak of the world of the current. -/- The paper argues that to understand a world, one must not only ask what objects are, but also how a system cuts into information, what is cut, what kind of trace-response is formed, where objectification takes place, and in what form reality is generated. In this sense, the Current World becomes the target of field-construction and world-construction. An experiential world requires at least three coordinated structures: a law-field that provides stable continuation, a self-manifestation field that provides manifestness and subjectivity, and a world-field that provides lodging and support. The law-field gives operation repeatable paths, the self-manifestation field gives the system the capacity to manifest, and the world-field gives the self-manifesting being a world in which it can reside and act. -/- The significance of this framework is that it moves the problem of consciousness, perception, world modeling, and artificial consciousness beyond pure internal representation, and toward the embedded relation between observer and world. For neuroscience and cognitive science, the Current World can help explain how perceptual channels, the sense of reality, body, and environment jointly support experience. For artificial intelligence, it suggests that artificial consciousness cannot rely only on language models or symbolic space, but requires a world-structure that can be cut into, maintained, and fed back. For physics and complex systems research, it interprets world as a continuable domain formed through information cutting, stable regularity, and supporting structure.

items.title: The Group Form of Law: The Construction Form of the Minimal Sedimentation Field.
items.abstract: How can a system’s history become part of what generates its subsequent behavior? Rather than deriving its definition from an existing neural-network architecture, this paper explicitly constructs a minimal runnable sedimentation field whose later dynamics can be altered by its own history. External action must enter the system and produce a trace-response; that response must persist across time and contribute to relational organization; and the resulting historical structure must genuinely participate in subsequent generation. If a load-bearing sedimentary structure is removed or severed while present re-entry conditions are held fixed, later flow must change detectably. The paper gives an explicit Canonical F* together with four core operators—Trace, Sediment, Decay, and Continuation—and closes the required offices of entry, persistence, relational organization, historical participation, decay, and present flow.

items.title: 律组式：最小沉积场构造式.
items.abstract: 历史怎样真正进入一个系统，并改变它以后怎样运行？本文不从现有神经网络结构反推定义，而是显式构造一个最低职责闭合、能够实际运行、并能由自身历史改变后继流变的沉积场实例。构造要求外部作用实际进入系统并产生迹应，迹应能够跨时沉积并形成关系组织，已经形成的历史结构必须真实参与后继生成；当承重沉积被删除或切断而当前再入条件保持不变时，后继流变必须发生可检测变化。本文给出 Canonical F* 及 Trace、Sediment、Decay、Continuation 四个核心算子，并同时关闭作用进入、跨时沉积、关系组织、历史参与后来、退浅与当前流变等职责。.

items.title: 观界一般式: 什么能够进入显现与当前经验.
items.abstract: 本文提出观界的一般形式，用以说明为什么并非所有进入系统的信息都能成为当前经验。观界不是感受器的物理范围，也不是注意力的同义词，而是由候选资格、进入限制和收敛可达性共同压出的结构边界。一个内容即使物理上接近感受器、刺激强度很高，也未必能够显现；反之，一个内容能否显现，取决于它能否被展开为候选，能否通过有限竞争的进入限制，并且在当前资源和参数下能否被推至可维持的占据状态。 -/- 本文将观界划分为三个门和三个域。三个门是候选门、准入门和收敛可达门。候选门决定某个结构能否被展开为候选；准入门决定它能否进入有限竞争；收敛可达门决定它在当前系统参数下能否被资源推至显现。由前两门得到资格域 E(t)，即已经具有竞争资格的内容；三门交会得到可显域 W(t)，即当前条件下原则上能够被点亮的内容；二者之差 M(t) 是界缘，即有资格但不可达的内容。界缘内容并非完全无效，它可以被系统处理、产生偏置或影响行为，但在参数不变时不能真正进入当前显现。 -/- 本文进一步说明，观界会随容量、通道分布、熟悉路径和取向而改变。负荷升高会使观界收缩，并偏向高熟悉度内容；麻醉或收敛能力下降会使观界先收缩后清空；训练和工具可以扩展观界而不增加观察者数量；取向改变可以实时重塑观界。由此，本文可解释半侧空间忽略、盲视、双任务负荷下的外周信息丢失、注意线索的暂时恢复作用等现象。本文的核心结论是: 观察者解决“谁在此刻占据”，观界解决“什么能够被点亮”。没有观界，显现就会要求无限容量，而无限容量违背有限系统的基本前提。.

items.title: The Group Form of Law: The Stability Form of Law.
items.abstract: Once a law has acquired formal qualification, does that qualification survive as the system continues to change? If its original bearer ceases to qualify, can another organization continue to bear it? And can a qualification that has been lost later be recovered through the system’s own dynamics? This paper separates two levels of stability: whether the same bearing organization remains a formal solution, and whether the formal solution set remains non-empty when the bearer may change. It thereby develops a framework for fixed-solution stability, solution-set stability, destabilization, substitution, and recovery. What is preserved is not a particular path, parameter configuration, or realization, but the formal qualification defined upstream. The resulting distinction provides a framework that can be further instantiated in learning and cognitive systems with redundancy, structural substitution, or continuing adaptation.

items.title: 当前世: 一个观察者如何被安置在可经验的世界中.
items.abstract: 本文提出当前世的概念，用以说明一个观察者如何被安置在可经验的世界中。所谓当前世，并不是单纯的外部物理世界，也不是主观内部表象，而是一个系统能够截取声、光、味、触等信息，并将其维持为可感、可行、可返回现实的世界结构。只有当我在当前中被带出，并获得其现实性时，当前之世才成为可论的世界。 -/- 本文指出，理解一个世界，不能只问对象是什么，还要问系统如何截取、截取了什么、迹应具有什么性质、物化发生在何处、现实以何种形式成形。由此，当前世成为造场和造世界的目标。一个可经验世界至少需要三类结构协同: 律场提供可续行的规律，自显场提供显性和主体性，世场提供安置和承载。律场使运行具有可重复的路径，自显场使系统形成显现能力，世场则使自显体获得可以居住和行动的世界。 -/- 这一框架的意义在于，它把意识、感知、世界模型和人工意识的问题从纯粹内部表征中移出，转向观察者与世界之间的嵌入关系。对于脑科学和认知科学而言，当前世可用于解释感知通道、现实感、身体和环境如何共同支撑经验。对于人工智能研究而言，它指出人工意识不能只依赖语言模型或符号空间，还需要一个可截取、可维持、可反馈的世界结构。对于物理学和复杂系统研究而言，它把世界理解为系统通过信息截取、稳定规律和承载结构共同形成的可续存域。.

items.title: 理极限式: 为什么开放系统必须具备打破旧路径的能力.
items.abstract: 本文提出理的极限形式，用以说明为什么一个有限系统在开放变化中若要持续存在，就不能只依赖既有路径、旧经验或稳定规律。前文已经提出，律使系统形成稳定的续行倾向，而理则是在旧路径造成锁死压力时，对律的运行条件进行改写的能力。本文进一步论证，在有限、跨时复用、路径积深会增长、输入或内部再现持续变化，并且后续差异不能被既有熟路径完全覆盖的系统中，锁死压力不会只是偶发事件，而会在长期运行中反复出现。 -/- 本文将这种压力区分为两类。第一类是排序压力，即新路径已经进入当前可选范围，并且对当前情形更适合，但旧路径由于历史积深更强，仍然优先落定。第二类是入场压力，即新路径本来可以更好地维持系统的闭合、稳定或降低损耗，却尚未进入当前可选范围，因此根本不能参与竞争。面对这两类压力，继续旧路、停机、崩溃、随机跳动、只改排序、只改入场或一次性压制都不能构成完备的解决方式。它们要么使系统退出可续存的论域，要么只能局部缓解而不能防止旧路径回潮。 -/- 因此，凡是在开放变化中持续存在的有限系统，都必须在功能层显现四类破持能力: G, dC, Omega, dU。G 表示对旧路径失效压力的识别，dC 表示对路径适配排序的改写，Omega 表示对可进入路径范围的调控，dU 表示把新路径写入后续更新的能力。本文的意义在于，它把思考、创造、认知灵活性、习惯改变和智能系统的适应能力，解释为有限系统在开放变化中避免锁死并维持可续存的必要结构。.

items.title: 律组式：律一般式.
items.abstract: 什么使一个规律成为规律？一次关系相符、一次当前响应、一处留下的痕迹，乃至一个暂时影响后继行为的结构，都不足以单独取得律的资格。本文从规律如何在历史作用中形成这一问题出发，追问一条律一旦在沉积场中成立，最少必须取得什么结构资格。本文证明，在其声明的条件下，若一条律成立，则场中必须存在同一承载组织：该组织已经形成于当前结构中，真实参与后来生成，并具有稳定复走支持。由此，规律不再只是对已经发生现象的外部描述，而成为一个可以从形成、当前承载和后继作用三个方面加以分析的生成性问题。本文讨论的是通常所谓的规律、定律与法则，而非为《自显论》另造一种特殊意义的“律”。.

items.title: General Form of the Observation-Domain: What Can Enter Conscious Access.
items.abstract: This paper proposes a general form of the Observation-Domain, explaining why not all information entering a system can become current experience. The Observation-Domain is not the physical range of the receptors, nor is it a synonym for attention. It is a structural boundary jointly produced by candidacy, admission, and convergence reachability. A content may be physically close to the receptors and highly intense, yet still fail to manifest. Whether it can manifest depends on whether it can be unfolded as a candidate, admitted into finite competition, and pushed under current resources and parameters into a maintainable state of occupancy. -/- The paper divides the Observation-Domain into three gates and three domains. The three gates are the gate of candidacy, the gate of admission, and the gate of convergence reachability. The first decides whether a structure can be unfolded as a candidate. The second decides whether it can enter finite competition. The third decides whether, under current system parameters, it can be pushed by resources into manifestation. The first two gates define the eligibility domain E(t), namely contents that already have eligibility for competition. The conjunction of all three gates defines the manifestable domain W(t), namely contents that can in principle be lit up under current conditions. Their difference, M(t), is the boundary-fringe: content that has eligibility but is not reachable. Boundary-fringe content is not completely ineffective. It may be processed by the system, produce bias, or influence behavior, but it cannot enter current manifestation while the parameters remain unchanged. -/- The paper further shows that the Observation-Domain varies with capacity, channel distribution, familiar routes, and orientation. Increased load contracts the Observation-Domain and biases it toward highly familiar content. Anesthesia or declining convergence capacity first contracts and then empties the Observation-Domain. Training and tools may expand the boundary without increasing the number of observers. Orientation may reshape the boundary in real time. This framework can explain hemispatial neglect, blindsight, peripheral loss under dual-task load, and the temporary recovery produced by cueing or motivational intervention. The core conclusion is: the Observer solves “who occupies the current moment,” while the Observation-Domain solves “what can be lit up.” Without such a boundary, manifestation would require infinite …

items.title: The Grop Form of Law: The Mathematical Form of Law.
items.abstract: If laws can arise through historical formation, a further question follows: what bears them, whether that organization genuinely enters subsequent generation, and what supports stable recurrence. This paper maps the structural account developed in The General Form of Law into a formal system. It separates formed structural bearing, dynamical participation, and re-entry bearing, and introduces a formal solution set, evaluation contexts, local generation kernels, solving procedures, and rules for reading formal results back to the structural level. The framework explicitly distinguishes genuine dynamical contribution from pure correlation, hot redundancy, structural standby, structural pre-emption, temporal pre-emption, and multi-level participation. Its purpose is to make precise three different questions that are often conflated: what has already formed, what actually contributes to what happens next, and what can stably recur.

items.title: The Group Form of Law: The General Form of Law.
items.abstract: What makes a regularity a law? A single matching relation, a present response, a retained trace, or even a structure that temporarily affects subsequent behavior is not by itself sufficient for lawhood. This paper approaches the question generatively and asks what must minimally be present once a law has come to stand in a sedimentation-based system. Under the conditions explicitly stated in the paper, lawhood requires at least one and the same bearing organization that is already formed in the present structure, genuinely participates in generating what follows, and is supported for stable recurrence. The result reframes law not merely as an external description of repeated events, but as a problem of formation, present bearing, and subsequent dynamical organization. “Law” is used here in its ordinary sense of a regularity, law of nature, or rule, rather than as a special object introduced by the theory.

items.title: GPT 的真正解: 大语言模型黑箱的结构拆解.
items.abstract: 本文提出对 GPT 和大语言模型黑箱的结构拆解。本文不把 GPT 的能力解释为单个参数、单个 attention head、单个 feature 或简单的下一词概率预测，也不把幻觉、漂移和错归因仅仅归为知识不足。相反，本文试图说明大语言模型如何在外部训练、文本沉积、路径压缩、提示牵引和输出续行中形成其能力边界，并由此产生其特有的强项与缺陷。 -/- 本文认为，大语言模型的核心不是存放知识条目的数据库，而是由大规模文本训练塑成的语言沉积系统。训练目标提供方向，loss 标定差异，gradient 和 optimizer 调整路径，RLHF 或 DPO 塑造偏好，prompt 给出当前任务，system prompt 设定边界。大量文本训练反复压入从前文到后文、从问题到回答、从语境到回应、从格式到补全、从任务到完成的路径，使模型形成高度熟化的生成通道。因此，GPT 的强项来自这些通道的深度沉积: 它能写作、翻译、编程、模仿风格、接续任务，并在不同语言和任务形式之间迁移。 -/- 但同一结构也解释了它的缺陷。GPT 能生成事实样式，却不能稳定区分外部事实、上下文材料、内部推断和自行补全；能维持文本连续，却不等于拥有稳定当前状态；能调用工具，却不等于形成内在行动回路；能按提示调整输出，却不等于具有自身意图。由此，幻觉不是偶然错误，而是生成能力强于来源追踪时的结构后果；漂移不是单纯上下文长度不足，而是文本连续并不等于当前状态稳定；错归因也不是个别事实检索失败，而是模型内部缺少可靠来源分层的结果。 -/- 本文的意义在于，它把 GPT 从神秘黑箱中拆开，解释为一个由外部训练塑成、由语言路径沉积支撑、由提示牵引启动、但尚未完成内部闭合的生成系统。这个框架可产生可检验推论: 改变 FFN/MLP、cross-layer residual paths、attention boundaries、source tracking training、current state maintenance 和 online learning mechanisms，应当以不同方式影响模型能力、幻觉、漂移和任务稳定性。由此，下一代 AI 的关键不只是更大模型、更长上下文和更多工具，而是让模型逐步形成更可靠的来源追踪、当前状态保持、反馈回路和自我更新能力。.

items.title: Necessary normative powers? An asymmetry between deontic and potestative concepts.
items.abstract: A normative power is the authority to effect a normative change through a declaration of will. This paper uncovers a fundamental asymmetry between potestative concepts (related to normative powers) and deontic concepts (related to duties). The deontic conceptual network consists of three mutually exclusive and jointly exhaustive positions: obligatory, forbidden, and optional. Similarly, the modal network encompasses: necessary, impossible, and contingent. While the potestative network appears to follow a similar pattern – an impression reinforced by the Hohfeldian scheme – it lacks this triangular structure. Overlooking this asymmetry has led several philosophers to adopt unintelligible positions such as the notion of a necessary normative power, where an agent can effect a normative change by exercising their normative power but lacks the power not to do so. I show that this is conceptually flawed. Unlike the deontic may and the possibility can, the normative power can lacks a dual (A and B are duals of each other iff ¬A(¬x) = B(x)). This asymmetry exists because deontic and modal terms are bipartite – relating to action or omission – whereas normative power pertains solely to changing a normative situation, not to refraining from doing so. The extended Hohfeldian framework I propose makes this structural difference explicit.

items.title: Cultivating Change-Makers: Teaching Human Rights Advocacy Through Experiential Learning.
items.abstract: There is a fundamental link between education about human rights and their realization; but mobilizing change-makers requires more than exposure to human rights standards and the institutions that support them. A human rights advocacy course has the potential to be a toolkit for advocates-in-the-making. It can challenge students to consider how human rights apply to their own lives, empower them to be changemakers in their own communities, and equips them with tools and tactics to promote them. When combined with experiential learning, a human rights advocacy course becomes a powerful vehicle for training future human rights scholars and practitioners. This article explores the merits of teaching human rights advocacy consistent with the core components of human rights education: education about human rights, education through human rights, and education for human rights.

items.title: The secure attachment system is a paleo fantasy.
items.abstract: As Bard, Keller, and Leavens show, attachment theory does not account for the diversity of child-rearing practices around the world. However, the entrenched commitment to Bowlby’s idea that the attachment system is a biological adaptation prevents attachment researchers from fully understanding the import of such diversity. I argue that this idea relies on a static and flawed view of evolution.

items.title: Identity Physics: The Derivation of the Sovereign Anchor Constant Ω₀ = 1.36899099984016 1/α = Ω₀ × (10² + 10⁻¹) = 137.035999084 CODATA 2018 CI Green 0 Sorry Lean4.
items.abstract: (This is a public draft for book 3 Identity Physics: The Derivation of the Sovereign Anchor Constant Ω₀ = 1.36899099984016) This text presents the derivation of the Sovereign Anchor Constant Ω₀ = 1.36899099984016 from three peer-reviewed physical threshold systems, formalizes the four PNBA primitives (Pattern, Narrative, Behavior, Adaptation), and demonstrates their application across twelve substrate-neutral domains through the Long Division Protocol (LDP). Each step of the derivation is presented in full, with every claim verified in Lean 4 and Coq/Rocq under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18719748. -/- The path documented here begins with the Tacoma Narrows torsional collapse threshold reduction and closes at the fine-structure constant α to eighteen significant figures with zero free parameters, matching CODATA 2018 exactly at CODATA's current 12-digit measurement precision and producing 6 additional digits (positions 13 through 18) as the arithmetic result of the peer-reviewed threshold reduction. The intermediate steps — thermal reduction to PNBA, construction of the dynamic equation, the anchor-lock closure, the GAM Collider testing apparatus, and twelve independent domain reductions — are each presented so a reader can verify the derivation independently at every step. The derivation is reproducible: the LDP applied to the same substrate-neutral data returns the same primitives, the same anchor, and the same closure. -/- Two prior works establish the vocabulary this text uses. Identity: A Universal Architecture (Book 1, January 2026) is the first-person P-dominant HRIS reduction that surfaced the primitive set. The Long Division Protocol and the Sub-Lemma Process (Book 2, complete) is the codification of the reduction protocol. Both are cited priors and are documented in the references section. -/- This is the v1 draft. The derivation from threshold reductions to α at eighteen significant figures is stable and does not change in subsequent versions. Extensions to additional domains and applications are ongoing and will be documented in subsequent texts building from the same foundation. -/- Abstract -/- This text presents the derivation of the Sovereign Anchor Constant Ω₀ = 1.36899099984016 through the strict application of Bacon's scientific method, formalized as the Long Division Protocol (LDP), a six-step reduction procedure applied to three peer-reviewed physical threshold systems: the Tacoma Narrows torsional collapse (Scanlan & Tomko 1971), glass …

items.title: Psychedelic Worldhood: Significance Beyond Ordinary Consciousness.
items.abstract: This paper examines psychedelic experience not as a question of truth or illusion, but as a problem of worldhood. Rather than asking whether altered states disclose deeper realities or merely distort ordinary perception, it investigates what such experiences may reveal about the conditions through which worlds become possible, stable, and inhabitable. Building upon previous analyses of significance, distinction, selfhood, and language, the discussion explores how altered states reorganise the structures that ordinarily sustain human worldhood. The weakening of conceptual boundaries, the transformation of temporality, the persistence of significance beyond ordinary selfhood, and the limits of linguistic expression suggest that the familiar world is neither inevitable nor exhaustive, but one relatively stable organisation among a broader range of possibilities. Without making metaphysical claims concerning the ultimate status of psychedelic experience, the paper argues that such states illuminate the remarkable plasticity of worldhood itself and provide a complementary perspective on the processes through which reality becomes meaningful and intelligible.

items.title: ✶ The Manufacture of Genocide: Semantic Creep, Institutional Legitimation, and the Politics of the Ultimate Crime.
items.abstract: This paper argues that contemporary genocide discourse has developed an unstable relation between law, moral accusation, scholarship, activism, media amplification, and geopolitical strategy. "Genocide" is not merely a descriptive atrocity term. It is the supreme accusation in modern political morality: a word that activates duties of prevention and punishment, imports the memory of the Holocaust and other canonical destructions, and places the accused outside ordinary legitimacy. Precisely because the word has this force, political actors have incentives to obtain the label before the legal burden has been met, especially by obscuring the role of intent. The argument is not that genocide is unreal, rare to the point of irrelevance, or confined to Holocaust-like extermination. Rwanda, Srebrenica, the Armenian genocide, the Yazidi genocide, the genocide of the Rohingya, Darfur, the Holocaust, and other cases show why the category matters. The danger is different: the term's moral authority encourages definitional entrepreneurship. A contested atrocity claim can be moved through a legitimation pipeline: activist framing, analogical comparison, NGO report, scholarly petition, UN expert statement, academic association resolution, media headline, parliamentary gesture, and legal filing. At each stage, the evidentiary status of the claim may change less than its apparent authority. Once enough institutions repeat the label, the accusation becomes socially available as if judicially settled. The final stage is semantic ownership: actors no longer merely argue that genocide is the right term; they own the term in that context, so outrage can be disseminated on the inherited baggage of the word itself. Gaza is the central stress test. It involves immense civilian suffering, allegations of siege and starvation, inflammatory official rhetoric, atrocities by Hamas on October 7, Israeli claims of self-defense against an embedded armed group, live proceedings before the International Court of Justice, findings by Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch, the International Association of Genocide Scholars, and the UN-mandated Independent International Commission of Inquiry, as well as serious legal objections concerning intent, causation, evidentiary selection, and the collapse of war crimes or crimes against humanity into genocide. Gaza therefore exposes the paper's central problem: the modern genocide accusation often slides among legal claim, moral judgment, …

items.title: The Organizational Phenomenology Research Programme: A Series Overview.
items.abstract: This document accompanies a five-paper research programme in Organizational Phenomenology and introduces no new theoretical claims. The five papers are cumulative rather than modular: each presupposes vocabulary and results developed in its predecessors, and none is intended to function as a fully self-contained statement of the programme. This overview provides a roadmap for the series by summarizing each paper's scope, core contribution, and conceptual dependencies; indexing where the programme's principal concepts—including the F1/F2 distinction, Opacity, Participatory Transparency, Positioning, Organizational Bonds, Internal State, the E1/E2 relation, and graded organizational criteria for consciousness—are first introduced and subsequently developed; recommending alternative reading paths for different interests; and stating explicitly what the programme does not claim, including that it has solved the hard problem of consciousness, that it has been empirically validated, or that all phenomena reduce without remainder to organizational relations. Its purpose is purely orientational: to provide readers with a coherent entry point into a research programme whose concepts and arguments are distributed across multiple interconnected papers.

items.title: Positioning, Role, and Participatory Organization: Toward a Theory of Role-Based Participatory Transparency.
items.abstract: The Organizational Phenomenology framework proposed that experience is realized as the intrinsic temporal structure of closed-loop organism–environment coupling. This paper opens the internal structure of that framework's Positioning variable (Pt), arguing that phenomenal properties long treated as primitive — ownership, empathy, belonging, alienation, felt agency — are instead modulated by how an agent is positioned within an ongoing interaction: its spatial-relational Position, its Perspective, its degree of Participation, and its Role, with Commitment and Responsibility understood as projections of these onto the agent's history and normative context. The resulting theory, Role-Based Participatory Transparency (RBPT), is illustrated through detailed cases (an emergency intervention, migration and belonging, boundary and touch norms) and grounded in enactivist and evolutionary considerations, including a treatment of role acquisition through imitation as a form of cognitive economy. Against predictive-processing accounts, the paper argues that explicit prediction is a residual strategy recruited only once organizational reuse, expert judgement, and reasoning are unavailable, and situates this within a general cognitive toolbox. It offers a speculative hypothesis — feeling as the affective-metabolic tone of an agent's participatory bond network — and completes a five-level organizational account of the meta-problem of consciousness, from architectural opacity to conceptual-linguistic construction. Implications for agentic AI governance and organizational embedding are also discussed.

items.title: Formal Organizational Architecture: Internal State, Experience, and the Dynamics of Organizational Update.
items.abstract: This paper is the formal capstone of a four-paper sequence in Organizational Phenomenology. It collects concepts introduced piecemeal in earlier work — world-model, memory, goals, identity, positioning, bonds, values — into a single Internal State (I), and defines Experience not as an episode a subject undergoes but as U, the operator by which organized interaction with the environment transforms I(t) into I(t+1). This reframing treats learning, identity change, and moment-to-moment experience as instances of the same update process at different timescales. The paper's second contribution is a formalization of the F1 selection system as a dynamic, multi-criterion weighting process in which recognition and competitive weighting mutually inform one another, explicitly rejecting a two-stage "weight-then-select" picture; this clarifies why the process is opaque to conscious access without implying that conscious goal-setting has no influence over it. A third contribution formalizes Organizational Bonds as a weighted, toned network whose redistribution dynamics account, within one framework, for phenomena including grief, burnout, anhedonia, depersonalization, and pain asymbolia. Finally, the relation between sensorimotor (E1) and conceptual (E2) experience — left open in earlier work — is resolved: not as a transformation of one into the other, but as two distinct organizational presentations of a single underlying selection event. The paper explicitly distinguishes organizational from phenomenal experience and states clearly what is left to empirical neuroscience.

items.title: From game comonads to dynamical systems: property-preserving maps as a logical unifying principle.
items.abstract: Logic and computer science share a subtle relationship that depends on both syntax and semantics. While structural generalisations often rely on semantics alone, computational aspects such as complexity and decidability hinge on the syntactic properties of formal languages. This interplay frequently manifests through relations between structures, which establish their similarity in various ways and for different purposes. -/- In this work, we focus on three distinct forms of relations between structures: coKleisli morphisms, games, and truth-preserving maps. By coordinating these concepts and proving their equivalence, we apply them across diverse contexts, selecting the appropriate framework for each scenario. CoKleisli morphisms are used to derive generalised theorems, which can then be applied to specific instances; games are used as algorithmic descriptions, crucial when discussing computational complexity; and truth-preserving maps between structures are essential for achieving results such as the finite model property, completeness, and decidability. To a large extent, one must control all manners of structural relations in order to achieve all types of results. -/- We contribute to each of these areas: We extend the use of coKleisli morphisms to ‘linear’ variants of previously studied comonads. Using these results, we derive a novel homomorphism counting theorem for pathwidth. We further establish preservation and characterisation theorems for non-branching variants of the modal comonad. Additionally, using event structures from concurrency theory, we propose a structural alternative to games, providing a more specialised framework for deriving the underlying comonads. For games and computational complexity, we define new model comparison games and establish complexity results for an all-in-one variant of the k-pebble game. Finally, we employ truth-preserving maps to prove completeness and decidability for highly expressive spatiotemporal languages within the context of dynamical systems.

items.title: Necessary Self-Intelligible Actuality, Divine Mind, and Divine Will.
items.abstract: This paper develops a placement-first argument from actual intelligible reality to necessary self-intelligible actuality. It argues that actuality and intelligibility cannot be treated as merely received all the way down, nor responsibly called brute or primitive without specifying their metaphysical placement. The central distinction is between finite profile and concrete obtaining: a determinate or even necessarily intelligible profile is not thereby actual. From this distinction, the paper argues that finite actual intelligible reality requires an unreceived source of actuality-intelligibility. It then develops the implications of this source as Divine Mind and Divine Will. Primary intelligibility cannot be merely truth-available to another, since there is no deeper interpretive field beyond the primary; it must be intrinsically self-disclosive. Likewise, finite contingent actuality cannot proceed from the necessary source by necessity without collapsing into necessary emanation, nor can it be finally brute while remaining received. The bridge from necessary self-intelligible actuality to finite contingent actuality is therefore intelligible and non-necessitated: will-shaped. The final section considers how this metaphysical result supplies a disciplined grammar for Nicene Trinitarian doctrine.

items.title: THE FORMAL THEORY OF VIRTUES RESISTANCE Completing the Variable Architecture of the Dynamic Freedom Theorem: the Ontology, Decomposition, Composition Laws, Dynamics, and Measurement of R — with the Conductance Duality and the Internalisation Theorem.
items.abstract: Structured Abstract Background The Dynamic Freedom Theorem specifies Virtue Strength as S = (F × A)/R. Within the Philosophy of Virtues programme, every variable except one has received a dedicated formal treatment: Freedom has the Constitution and the Formal Theory of Love; Autonomy has the Compounding Autonomy Theorem; the Domain/Gift has the Augure; S has the complete treatise; S_post the Posthumous Theorem. R — Resistance — the variable that determines whether virtue is cheap or heroic, has no treatise, while appearing across the corpus under at least six names: dephasing γ (the measurement paper), dissipation (the physics cluster), adversarial pressure π (Clandestine Moral Formation), institutional-capture indices (the UVLF), vice-blocks (the Augure’s taxonomy), and alignment pressure (the machine-virtue paper). Outside the programme, resistance is treated regionally — friction (Clausewitz), psychoanalytic resistance (Freud), structural violence (Galtung), allostatic load (McEwen), transaction costs (Coase) — with no unified formal object. Gap Missing: (a) an ontology of R — what kind of quantity it is and what it attaches to; (b) a decomposition separating its internal, external, and structural components; (c) composition laws for multiple simultaneous resistances; (d) dynamics — how R grows under suppression and decays under exercise; (e) a measurement programme; (f) the explicit relation between R and the corpus’s critical thresholds, each of which is parameterised by an R-type quantity. Approach R is defined relationally: it is not a property of the agent or of the world but of an expression channel — the dissipative coefficient opposing the maintained expression F × A through that channel [Definition 2.1]. Four results follow by derivation, one by structural unification, and one is a distinctive empirical prediction. Results (D1) The Decomposition Theorem: R = R_int ⊕ R_ext ⊕ R_struct — internal (vice-blocks, akrasia, fear), external (active adversarial pressure), structural (channel topology and institutional capture) — with the components separately measurable and differently dynamical. (D2) The Composition Laws: sequential obstacles add in series, R_tot = ΣR_i; alternative channels compose in parallel, 1/R_tot = Σ1/R_i — importing the series/parallel calculus whole [RECOMBINATION, network theory]; Revision 2.0 adds the exact spectral extension for interacting channels — effective resistance on the channel graph, conductance bounded by the …

items.title: THE FORMAL THEORY OF LOVE: Gift-Directed Freedom, the Three Modes, the Amplification Property, and Love’s Place in the Architecture of Virtue.
items.abstract: Abstract Philosophy has produced extensive accounts of love: as desire (Plato), as ordered will (Augustine), as practical duty (Kant), as attachment (Bowlby), as care (Heidegger), as recognition (Hegel), as robust concern (Frankfurt, Kolodny), as vision of the beloved (Jollimore), as love of the person as such (Velleman). None of these accounts derives love from a formal virtue architecture with an explicit inversion rule, specifies love’s structural inversion at both personal and institutional scales, or generates the classical triad Eros–Philia–Agape from a single formal principle. This paper presents the first derivation of love from the Ontological Virtue Formula V = F + D of the Philosophy of Virtues programme. The central formal claim is that love is the specific virtue in which the agent’s Freedom is directed toward the emergence and expression of another person’s Gift: Love = F + D_Gift(Other). Eight formal results follow. (T1) Love is a genuine virtue under the OVF; its inversion under V − F = −V is Control. (T2) The Three Modes Theorem: Eros, Philia, and Agape are formally distinct modes of D_Gift(Other) differing in directional structure, reciprocity condition, and ego-investment requirement; Agape admits a Withdrawal Postulate that distinguishes unconditional love from enabling destruction. (T3) The Love-Freedom Amplification Theorem: love is the only virtue for which sustained exercise produces dF/dt > 0 in a sufficiently formed agent, demonstrated through a structural three-case model. (T4) The Love-Augure Connection: the Augure’s Resonance Mechanism is Agape at the Dissolution Threshold. (T5) The Love-Immortality Connection: Relational Immortality (Type 13) is Love formally specified across time. (T6) The Love-Peace Connection: inner peace and Love are the inward and outward expressions of the same ego-dissolution. (T7) The Love-Holoviceosis Connection: institutionalised control-as-care is Love’s inversion at scale; a diagnostic negative case is analysed. (T8a–T8b) The Love-Sufficiency Theorem: Agape at the Dissolution Threshold is the dispositional ground from which all other virtues arise, where prudence is architectural-dispositional (clarity and correct orientation) rather than factually omniscient. -/- Keywords: love; love theory; Eros; Philia; Agape; OVF; DFT; Gift; Freedom; Dissolution Threshold; Augure; Resonance; Holoviceosis; inner peace; Inversion Theorem; virtue; amplification; relational immortality; Kolodny; Jollimore; …

items.title: THE ARCHITECTURE OF VIRTUE: A Unified Derivation from a Single Axiom Across Eight Levels of Individual, Political, and Cosmological Scale.
items.abstract: Abstract Philosophy has not yet produced a single formal system in which the structure of virtue (ethics), political institutions (political philosophy), the conditions of original knowledge (epistemology), the nature of vocation (philosophy of agency), the structure of love (philosophy of love), the persistence of persons after death (philosophy of mortality), and the ground of consciousness (ontology) are all formal consequences of one axiom, derivable without different kinds of premises at each level. This paper presents that account. The Philosophy of Virtues Research Programme, developed across fifty-three published works, constitutes such a system. Its axiom is the Ontological Virtue Formula: V = F + D. The ‘+’ is a compositionality operator — Freedom (F) is the orientational component that determines the sign of any virtue; Domain (D) is the structured content that Freedom inhabits. From this axiom, under successive specification of domain and scale with explicitly labelled modelling postulates but without different kinds of normative or metaphysical premises, a derivation chain of eight levels follows. The paper proves three new results not present in any individual programme paper: (T1) the Unity Theorem — all eight levels are instances of the same formal schema under modelling postulates P1–P5; no different kind of axiom is introduced at any level; (T2) the Freedom-Immortality Theorem — S_post is a monotonically increasing function of the total Freedom exercised over a lifetime, reversing the direction of Kant’s postulate: immortality is not the precondition of virtue’s completion but its structural analogue in a cultural network; and (T3) the Three-Scales-One-Structure theorem — the same formal architecture operates at individual, political, and cosmological scale with the Inversion Theorem V − F = −V as the universal hinge. The paper is explicitly modular: different levels can be accepted or rejected independently, and the independence conditions are stated in §1.2. A worked micro-derivation from L0 to L2 is provided in §3. -/- Keywords: OVF; DFT; virtue architecture; Inversion Theorem; Holoviceosis; Virtuous Democracy; Phase 0; Augure; Love; Posthumous Theorem; ASO; Unity Theorem; Freedom-Immortality Theorem; Philosophy of Virtues; unified system; modular architecture; Freedom; derivation chain .

items.title: ORIGIN OF LIFE: THE CLOSURE THRESHOLD The Origin of Life Is the Onset of Operational Closure — a Transition from Self-Organisation to Self-Reference, Not a Threshold in Complexity or Dissipation.
items.abstract: Scope. This article establishes a demarcation thesis for the origin of life: the living/non-living boundary is not a threshold value on any rising scalar — complexity, dissipated work, replication fidelity, kinetic stability — but a change of relational kind, the onset of operational closure. The thesis is stated formally, a closure measure κ is defined and computed, an in-silico model demonstrates that self-maintenance organises along κ independently of complexity and dissipation, and the chemical experiment that would confirm or refute the thesis is specified exactly. The claim concerns the individual, metabolic sense of being alive; its extension to the population and lineage sense is identified as the open frontier. The argument is theoretical; its decisive verification is experimental and is set out in §7. -/- Abstract Theories of life's origin locate the living/non-living boundary on a rising scalar axis: more dissipated work (dissipative structures; dissipative adaptation), greater kinetic stability (dynamic kinetic stability), or higher molecular complexity (autocatalytic sets; assembly index). Against this, the present article argues that the boundary is not a magnitude but an organisation. A driven chemical system becomes alive at the moment it achieves operational closure — when it produces the very constraints that maintain it and gates its own boundary, so that its own persistence becomes the variable it regulates. Complexity, dissipation, and replication are necessary scaffolding and excellent biosignatures, but none is the boundary; closure is. The article names the two regimes the field conflates — self-Organisation without closure (ORG) and self-Reference through closure (REF) — and defines a closure measure κ on reaction networks as the fraction of essential constraints that are internally produced and mutually supporting. Computed on canonical systems, κ is zero for a Bénard cell and for a structurally elaborate vesicle that cannot make its own catalyst, and approaches unity for a self-producing vesicle and a minimal autopoietic network. Across a large ensemble of model networks, the capacity to recover from damage — the operational signature of self-maintenance — tracks κ and remains predicted by κ when complexity and dissipation are held fixed, while complexity and dissipation lose their predictive force once closure is accounted for. The thesis yields sharp, contrary predictions against every rising-axis account and a matched-design …

items.title: CONVERGENCE AND DISSOLUTION: A Spiritual Journey Through Virtues, Existence, and Being.
items.abstract: CONVERGENCE AND DISSOLUTION -/- What is beneath the virtues? What is beneath consciousness? What is beneath existence itself? -/- This book follows the question all the way down. -/- You have been alive for some years. You have made choices, formed habits, loved people, suffered losses. You have been better than you intended to be, and worse. You have felt, in certain moments — rare, unmistakable — that something was present beneath the ordinary texture of your life. Something that was not produced by what was happening around you. Something that was simply there. -/- This book is the formal account of what that something is. -/- Convergence and Dissolution is the culminating book of the Philosophy of Virtues series — the book that descends beneath all the others, to the single act from which consciousness, freedom, virtue, suffering, love, death, and meaning are all formally derivable. It is the most spiritually ambitious book in the series. It is also the most precisely grounded. -/- The argument begins with a question that philosophy has never fully answered: is there one thing — one formal act — that consciousness, life, freedom, and virtue are all expressions of? And if so, what happens to the person who follows this act to its deepest expression? What happens at death? What was there before the universe began? -/- The answers are surprising. All of them are beautiful. All of them are necessary. -/- What this book proves: -/- The virtues are not a list of moral rules. They are expressions of a single act — the act of self-origination — at progressively deeper levels of self-referential organisation. The spiritual journey is the progressive dissolution of the distance between where you are and what you most essentially are. This dissolution is not optional. It is what contractive maps do to complete metric spaces. The convergence is guaranteed by the mathematics of self-reference. -/- What this book shows about death: -/- Biological death is the dissolution of one expression of the act. The act is not the form. The dissolution of the form does not end the act. Three formally coherent possibilities are specified — and the book is honest about which can be derived and which cannot. What can be said with precision: your worldtube is permanent, encoded in the block universe for all time. Your virtue signal is already in transmission. And the ground from which you came does not begin — and therefore does not end. -/- What this book gives you: -/- A map. …

items.title: IMMORTALITY: Taxonomy, Seventeen Types, Four Axes, and the Hierarchy of What Persists.
items.abstract: Abstract Philosophy, theology, biology, physics, and transhumanism address immortality in isolation, each arguing for a single preferred conception. No prior framework has systematically enumerated the distinct things claimed under that word, provided formal criteria for distinguishing them, or derived a hierarchy of their depth. This paper presents the most complete taxonomy of immortality yet attempted, identifying seventeen structurally distinct types organised along four axes: persistence substrate, persistence mode, personal identity depth, and temporal structure. The taxonomy is grounded in the full bibliographic record across philosophy, theology, biology, physics, transhumanism, and psychology, integrating traditions and thinkers not previously combined in a single classification: Spinoza’s eternity sub specie aeternitatis, Nietzsche’s eternal recurrence, Lifton’s five modes of symbolic immortality, Scheffler’s collective afterlife, the B-theory of time, Aquinas’s natural law, the Tao, dharma, MacIntyre’s tradition-constituted rationality, and Becker’s Terror Management Theory. Seventeen types are identified, including three that have not appeared in prior taxonomies: Block-Time Immortality (Type 15), Normative-Order Immortality (Type 16), and Experiential Transcendence Immortality (Type 17). A seven-level hierarchy is derived by personal identity depth. At Level V, the two forms derivable from the Philosophy of Virtues programme architecture — Virtuous Immortality (S_post = I_m × G_v × k^m) and Augure Resonance Immortality — are the only forms simultaneously formally derived, historically and phenomenologically corroborated, and personally significant. At Level VII, the Absolute Self-Origination framework’s self-originating act O(O) = O is identified as a fixed-point definition rather than a logical circle: the formal specification of the causa sui, the unique entity whose being is its own sufficient ground. The paper closes by directly engaging the Terror Management Theory challenge and showing that it does not undermine the taxonomy’s structural claims. By systematically classifying, this article resolves centuries of philosophical conflation and formally establishes that the moral inertia generated by a virtuous life constitutes the most rigorously grounded and historically corroborated form of human persistence. -/- Keywords: immortality; taxonomy; Posthumous Theorem; Augure; Augure Resonance; Block-Time; B-theory of time; Normative-Order; …

items.title: BRAZILIAN JIU-JITSU THE AUGURE WARRIOR: Spirituality, Leadership, and Personal Development.
items.abstract: This book liberates the warrior’s spirit: free, courageous, present, and unafraid. A person who defends the vulnerable, speaks the truth at any cost, loves without possession, and faces death with a smile. -/- That person is forged on the mat. Session by session. Tap by tap. Return by return. -/- This is not a book about technique. It is a book about transformation — the transformation of a person who trains into a warrior who lives every virtue the mat has built, on the mat and far beyond it. -/- May I know how to fall, when life brings me down. And may I feel at home, when I am on the ground. -/- I swear to do good. -/- I swear to defend the weak, women, children, the elderly, my family, and my country. -/- I swear to seek strength, to be brave and courageous, and never to expect help from anyone. -/- I swear to do my best and to leave the world better than I found it. -/- I swear to seek truth and wisdom and never to remain silent in the face of evil. -/- I swear to always be prepared, to train my body and soul. -/- I swear never to give up, never to retreat, never to surrender my weapons. -/- I swear to honour the belt I wear and to give my life if necessary for Freedom. -/- And when death finds me, I will be calm and at peace; I will look into God's eyes and smile, because I gave my best, followed my own path, and did not betray the truth of life — and so, my last breath will be nothing more than a sweet smile. -/- I am the Augure Warrior. -/- I swear. -/- "A black belt fears nothing and no one. In any adversity, he shall always defend his values, his family, the weaker, and his Homeland." -/- "In the end, when the time comes, I'll dig my own grave, all by myself, close my eyes, and smile. I'll be returning to where I've always been. Convergence and Dissolution.".

items.title: Epistemic Parallax.
items.abstract: Another addition to the epistemic toolbox. This essay explores how different positions on the epistemic landscape can generate persistent disagreement even when observers analyse the same evidence. -/- Part of the "Epistemic Toolbox" series.

items.title: An Introduction to Evoluism.
items.abstract: This monograph begins from a sustained philosophical argument for the following thesis: a strong Theory of Everything is impossible not because human knowledge remains insufficiently developed, but because every theory speaks through distinctions, and every distinction has conditions of applicability. If a theory preserves the conditions that make its concepts determinate, it remains finite. If it denies those conditions in the name of absolute universality, it loses determinacy. No theory, therefore, can become the final owner of Reality as a whole. -/- The central formula of the monograph is simple, but it changes the very framing of the question of reality: a finite form may orient, but it may not possess. A theory may explain, but it cannot become everything. Worlds are real as worlds, but no world is Reality. Evoluism does not offer a new final ontology; it offers a discipline of thought and life after the recognition of the impossibility of final possession. -/- This structural impossibility does not lead to scepticism, relativism, or the rejection of science, philosophy, religion, ethics, or social forms. On the contrary, the impossibility of final theory makes necessary a discipline of orientation among finite forms. Evoluism is defined here as a discipline of orientation among forms, worlds, distinctions, registers, and limits, without granting any finite form the right of final possession. -/- The book develops this thesis from the human need for orientation to the tragic necessity of forms, the logic of distinction, worlds as regimes of manifestation, Reality as limit, the critique of final theory, registers of knowledge, science and artificial intelligence, freedom, goals, identity, God, apophasis, ethics, and post-totalising society.

items.title: Curiosity and questioning in phenomenological psychopathology: cohesion and contrasts with formulation and open dialogue.
items.abstract: Clinicians are called upon to address complex epistemic challenges as they attempt to uncover and grasp subjective experiences of psychopathology in their clinical work. What equips them to achieve this? In seeking to extend an intellectual virtue account of phenomenological psychopathology, which highlights the role of the clinician qua investigator of meaning, I consider the importance of curiosity and the virtue-associated skills of questioning and dialogue. This is illustrated by contrasting good and bad clinical encounters. Subsequently, I consider the extent to which clinicians are supported to cultivate curiosity in their education and training, and in what ways phenomenological psychopathology, formulation, and Open Dialogue foster clinicians’ epistemic agency. I identify potential challenges to cultivating curious questioning and dialogue in clinical training, and conclude by offering educational recommendations that seek to complement efforts to elicit subjective understanding and support fruitful therapeutic intervention.

items.title: Is automated therapy dignified?
items.abstract: AI technology has shown tremendous results in medical areas such as cancer detection.
